messages.text: How did Steve build the LinkedIn Growth Loop, step by step?

claims.text: LinkedIn Growth Loop began as one small daily job: review a list of people, understand why each belonged there, write a personalized connection note, send or skip, then record what happened.
Target review gave the loop a real starting point: who this person is, why they fit, and whether the next action should happen.
Response tracking made the next run smarter: the system could keep the outcome, compare it with prior choices, and decide what changed.
Later, the scope widened into target discovery, feed interaction, response tracking, follow-up state, and outcome comparison.
Steve then stopped treating the workflow as one agent and split it into two operating groups: people work, and public interaction.
